name: Canh hen
summary: Canh hến is the clam soup on the city introduction. The broth is the clam liquor. The clam meat is stir-fried until fragrant and added back with a green, often rau bầu, rau lang, mồng tơi, rau dềnh, or rau muống. The city introduction calls it a summer lunch.
origin: Vinh. The city introduction lists món hến under đặc sản, and canh hến is the first bowl.
taste: The city introduction says the soup is sweet, rich in the clam, and cooling.
howToEat: Order it at a summer lunch. The city introduction says the soup is sweet, full of the clam, and cooling. It does not print a shop or a price. A price is Check on arrival. A month was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: A street was not printed. Check on arrival.
